login.title: jellylab
login.partialBody:
{{error}}

Browsing and playback work. Requests and search need Jellyseerr - check its address in Servers.

servers.title: Servers
servers.noneBody: Add a Jellyfin + Jellyseerr pair to get started.
servers.deleteMessage: Remove "{{name}}" from this device. This does not affect the server itself.
servers.switchMessage: Sign out of the current server and connect to "{{name}}".

serverEdit.name: Name
serverEdit.hint: Include the scheme (http:// or https://) and no trailing slash. Both servers must be reachable from this device — LAN, VPN mesh, or public.
serverEdit.missingBody: Fill in a name and both URLs.

downloads.emptyBody: Anything you download for offline watching shows up here.
downloads.removeBody: {{title}} will be removed from this device. It stays on the server.
downloads.startBody: This will use about {{size}} on this device.
downloads.label: Download for offline
downloads.playingOffline: Playing the copy on this device
downloads.seasonBody: About {{size}} in total. They arrive one at a time, so the first is watchable while the rest come in.
downloads.seasonNone: Every episode in this season is already on this device.
downloads.stopBody: What has arrived of {{title}} is deleted.

library.unavailableBody: Nothing answered. Check that the server is running, then try again.
library.unavailableAuth: Your session has expired. Sign out and back in to reconnect.
library.rowFailed: This row didn't load. Tap to try again.

search.failedBody: Could not reach Jellyfin or Jellyseerr.

check.deadEndWhy: This will not resolve on its own. The quality profile has to allow one of them.
check.rejectWhy: Keeps the record, stops the searching. Undo it in Jellyseerr.
check.searching: Asking every indexer. This can take a minute or two.
check.untrackedWhy: Nothing was ever added to Sonarr or Radarr for this.

requests.signedOut: Sign in to Jellyseerr to see your requests

confirmDeleteRequest.title: Delete request?
confirmDeleteRequest.message: The request will be cancelled but any downloaded files stay on Jellyfin.

confirmRemove.title: Remove from Jellyfin?
confirmRemove.message: This removes the media from Jellyseerr and asks Radarr/Sonarr to remove the file. Irreversible.

detail.castHint: Cast: {{state}} · AirPlay picker is inside the player

profile.title: Profile
profile.nameSaved: Name updated. Restart the app to see it everywhere.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.note: Preferences are stored on this device. When the player finds a matching subtitle track for the media, it will be selected automatically.

playback.title: Playback
playback.autoplayNextDesc: Automatically play the next episode of a TV show when the current one ends.
playback.preferVLCDesc: Skip AVPlayer entirely. Slower start, works with every codec and container.
playback.note: The player still auto-selects VLC when a file's container or codec is not AVPlayer-compatible. Enabling 'Always use VLC' bypasses AVPlayer even for MP4/H.264 files.
playback.engineNote: Auto picks AVPlayer when the file’s container and codec are supported and falls back to VLC otherwise. Force AVPlayer if you always want the native iOS player; force VLC for maximum compatibility (MKV, DTS, TrueHD, VP9, AV1) at the cost of slower startup.
playback.qualityNote: Best available sends the file exactly as it is on the server: the best picture, and the most data. The others ask the server to shrink it, which helps on mobile data or a slow connection. Anything already smaller than your choice is sent untouched.
playback.originalNote: Original picks the language the thing was made in - Japanese for anime, French for a French film - so you do not have to set one language for everything.

content.title: Content
content.showAdultDesc: Include 18+ movies and TV in Search and Discover. Applies on this device only. Your Jellyseerr server must also allow adult content globally for it to appear.
content.adminIntro: The device toggle above only hides adult results on this phone. To control it for the whole server (and per user), open Jellyseerr:
content.nonAdminNote: Only the device toggle is available for non-admin accounts. Server-wide adult content control lives in Jellyseerr's admin.

language.title: Language
language.note: Restart the app for menu titles and system dialogs to fully update.

about.title: About
about.tmdbCredit: Artwork and metadata from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

player.noDevices: No devices found on this network.
player.delayHint: Plus shows subtitles later, minus shows them earlier.
player.delayHintOff: Pick a track under External to adjust its timing. Embedded tracks are drawn by VLC, which offers no timing control.
player.transcodedAudio: This file has {{tracks}} audio tracks, but it is being transcoded and the server sends only one. Set playback quality to Original to switch between them.
player.castHint: The AirPlay picker is inside the player.
player.pipUnavailableBody: This file plays through VLC, which has no picture in picture. Settings → Playback → Always use AVPlayer will transcode it on the server so PiP works, at the cost of some work for the server.

request.deleteBody: The request will be cancelled but any downloaded files stay on Jellyfin.
request.nothingBody: Every season is already available, downloading, or has not aired yet.
request.qualityNote: Sets what this title looks for. It stays one entry in your library - a better release replaces the file, it never adds a second copy.
request.removeBody: This removes the media from Jellyseerr and asks Radarr/Sonarr to remove the file. Irreversible.
request.seasonsNote: Seasons already available, downloading or not yet aired cannot be requested - that is why they are greyed out rather than hidden.
request.stalledBody: Approved {{days}} days ago and nothing has started downloading. Usually that means no release exists that fits your quality rules, or the ones that do have no seeders.
request.waitingCinema: Still in cinemas. Nothing to download until the digital release on {{date}} - your server will pick it up automatically then.
request.waitingMatch: Approved and waiting for a match. Your server keeps searching, so this can take a while if nothing good is available yet.

history.empty: Nothing finished yet. Anything you watch to the end shows up here.
